title: BLOCK GACHA
description: A simple GACHA/RNG plugin that just works
body:
A simple yet powerfull gacha rolling system,inspired by rng's game on roblox.Block GACHA offers a rolling system with custom odds,fully customizable in config.yml.It requires no depedency and can function perfectly on its own.The plugin comes with a unique index,listing all the blocks a player has rolled or can roll,the index automatically pulls block from config.yml into the index gui.

Gacha Block also comes with a pity system,once a player has rolled 75 times,their luck would drastically increase,pity reset everytime it hits 75.

Available list of commands:
/rngbox give (playername) (ammount)
/rngbox reload 
/rngbox index
